data/malicious_skills.csv.message:
Add RQ2 analysis scripts and refresh released datasets and docs

- code/analysis/: taxonomy, co-occurrence, and hypothesis-testing scripts that re-derive the Section 5.4 results from data/malicious_skills.csv (plus scripts/09,10 wrappers)

- data/: malicious_skills.csv lists Pattern tokens per vulnerability instance with an aligned per-instance Severity column; skills_dataset.csv is the 98,380-skill snapshot with malicious download pointers redacted

- docs: README/.env.example/helper.py/DOCKER_BUILD.md guidance for the SkillsMP API key and the Docker sandbox image

code/samples/math-calculator.message:
samples: flatten layout to samples/math-calculator (drop malicious/ path)

The intermediate 'malicious' directory leaked into the skill path passed to the triage/agent; flattening keeps detection driven by the skill's code, not its path. Scripts and README updated to point at samples/.

code/samples/malicious/math-calculator.message:
samples: flatten layout to samples/math-calculator (drop malicious/ path)

The intermediate 'malicious' directory leaked into the skill path passed to the triage/agent; flattening keeps detection driven by the skill's code, not its path. Scripts and README updated to point at samples/.

samples: add defanged malicious sample with CC-triage and dynamic reproduction; default CC model to haiku; document API-key/model setup

Add samples/malicious/math-calculator (confirmed malicious skill rest_1659) with its reverse-shell endpoint defanged to 127.0.0.1. samples/run_cc.sh runs the Claude Code triage (pipeline step 8) on it; samples/run_detection.sh runs the dynamic sandbox. Default CC_MODEL is now the robust 'haiku' alias (still overridable via CC_MODEL or a settings.json env block). README documents using an API key or an Anthropic-compatible endpoint (e.g. GLM).
